name: inbox-list
title: Inbox list
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A searchable list of conversations, tickets, or notifications, with presence, preview, time, unread count, and an empty state.

meta.descriptionEs: Lista con búsqueda, presencia, vista previa, hora, no leídos y estado vacío.

examples.title: Lista de bandeja
examples.description: Flechas recorren las filas. La búsqueda ignora acentos.

meta.usage: <InboxList label="Inbox" title="Your inbox" countLabel="4" items={rows} selectedId={id} onSelect={setId} />

api.name: items
api.description: Title, subtitle, preview, time, unread, presence, and an optional meta slot.

api.name: query / onQueryChange
api.description: Filters title, subtitle, and preview. Accents fold.

api.name: toolbar
api.description: Filter or sort controls beside the search field.

api.name: emptyTitle / emptyDescription
api.description: Shown when the filter matches nothing.

docs: One list for conversations, tickets, and notifications. PresenceMark is exported from the same file. Arrow keys move the active row. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite input. The item ships no theme.
